As World Cancer Day approaches, I am glad to see President Biden lay out such an ambitious goal. Earlier detection and expanded treatment options can save countless lives.
https://t.co/B7hfVyMmXJ

This is very good news!
https://t.co/YGGowzDwwL

This is the beginning of National Eating Disorder Week. We must ensure that every American in need of mental health and eating disorder treatment has access, especially due to increased challenges throughout the COVID-19 pandemic.

The White House says we are headed for “a lot of unnecessary loss of life” if Congress does not act upon more pandemic funding for vaccines, testing, and treatment. We must prepare ourselves for the next wave. 
https://t.co/asYCDrBKvy

Last year, nearly 108,000 Americans lost their lives to drug overdoses. That's why I'm proud to stand with my colleagues as #CongressGoesPurple to celebrate National Recovery Month.

If you find yourself struggling, know that recovery is possible. https://t.co/8dQwiBGCXu https://t.co/9m7OLYjaeJ

Pregnant women are less likely to treated for substance abuse disorders despite being more likely to die from it. This is an important step to close this gap while combatting substance abuse across the board. https://t.co/SDU0yH9lnt
An incomprehensible loss. We must continue to expand access to substance abuse treatment and emergency overdose care. https://t.co/FZzUbmKlWK

The IRS has a long-standing policy mandating annual audits of the sitting president and vice president but skipped them for President Trump, until Congress asked why. We need to understand why Donald Trump was apparently receiving special treatment. https://t.co/gTFOm3upw8
Really encouraging news, thanks to steady progress in improving cancer treatments, increasing early detection efforts, and limiting unhealthy habits like smoking. https://t.co/0FT44K7QjK

Members of Congress are no different from everyone else when it comes to mental health. @JohnFetterman deserves praise for his courage and leadership in sharing his experience with what he's facing. https://t.co/QdrYKu6PeQ

The FDA approved Mifepristone more than two decades ago because it was found to be both safe and effective, conclusions which have been affirmed by its use since. We must continue to expand access to reproductive health care. https://t.co/Xb0xHjkOQ7

Last night's Taiwan tabletop exercise was a valuable way for @CmteOnCCPDems to understand how we can work in the future to maintain peace and deter any future aggression by the CCP.

I particularly appreciated the participation from members of both parties. Thank you! https://t.co/Unhbe1gP4v

The exercise @CmteOnCCPDems joined last week was a “prepare for the worst, hope for the best” situation. We do not seek any conflicts, and that's why we must be ready to prevent them. https://t.co/6roeR6VjhF

Last week, @CmteOnCCPDems staged a simulation exercise to understand how the U.S. would respond to a potential invasion of Taiwan by the CCP. Check out this clip from @ThisWeekABC on how it went. https://t.co/17MJggiu90

Ending the drug misuse epidemic means investing in programs like Elk Grove Village Cares, which helps those struggling with addiction to receive treatment. I was proud to secure $500,000 in federal funding to support their efforts and to expand the program to help adolescents. https://t.co/pyIayPkDjz

Tuberculosis remains a widespread and deadly infectious disease around the world, with over 10 million people contracting it in 2021. A successful vaccine would be major breakthrough. https://t.co/XHFLkTxfVN

One thing became very clear from the war games exercise @CmteOnCCPDems held a few months ago: any conflict between the U.S. and the PRC would be devastating for both sides.

Our committee is committed to finding concrete solutions to make sure we avoid such a scenario. https://t.co/xqXXjdbgIV

I visited Hanover Park's wastewater treatment facility yesterday to present a check for the $600,000 in federal funding I secured to upgrade its UV disinfectant system and keep our waterways clean. Glad I could celebrate with leaders including Mayor Rod Craig and @repdeliaramirez https://t.co/kIueHdz2qr
With cancer diagnosis on the rise among Americans under 50, it’s never too early to discuss checkups, family history, and preventive measures with your health care provider. https://t.co/2u5bMQGEF0
Sending my best wishes to Rep. Scalise and his family as he begins his treatment. https://t.co/CbDiHoXbia

Demand for food is rising at the same time food prices are increasing. It’s critical to the health and nutrition of families that any budget deal does not cut funding to important programs like SNAP.
https://t.co/fRViXVDc5A

.@RepWexton has served the people of Virginia and our country with dignity and commitment at every turn, and her presence in the House will be deeply missed. My family and I are keeping her in our thoughts. https://t.co/RG3FsUonOd

Glad to see Pennsylvania join states like Illinois in adopting automatic voter registration.  This decision will ensure more people can exercise their right to vote, and will strengthen our democracy as a result. https://t.co/tMIJ7qXRgo

The CCP is continuing its wrongful imprisonment of the Uyghur people. We must do all we can to end this cruel treatment of religious minorities by the CCP.
https://t.co/foJC8QyZLR

Millions of Americans are still living with and recovering from the symptoms of long COVID. Studies like these are critical to understanding what causes long COVID and how we can combat it.
https://t.co/heNUM13psa
